departments.title: Departments
departments.intro: Group your pipelines by team so they're easier to find, filter and report on. Departments are optional. A pipeline without one is filed under No department.
departments.builtIn: Built in. It can't be renamed or deleted.
departments.howBody: Pick a department when you create a pipeline, or leave it as No department. Recruiters and hiring managers only see pipelines in the departments you give them access to in {link}. Pipelines in No department are visible to admins only. Deleting a department never deletes its pipelines or candidates.

role.title: Job title
role.departmentHintRecruiter: Pipelines go in one of your departments.
role.noDepartments: You aren't in any department yet, so you can't save a pipeline. Ask an Admin to give you access to one.
role.jdPlaceholder: Paste the full job description here: responsibilities, requirements and what success looks like.
role.jdHint: Shown to candidates on your apply page. FastHyr also reads it to screen résumés and plan each interview.
role.mustHavesHint: Hidden criteria FastHyr looks for when reading each résumé. It checks for related experience, not an exact match, so close or transferable experience still counts. Add at least 3, as they're also used to score candidates. Candidates won't see this list, but you can still mention these in the job description so applicants are aware of them.
role.mustHavesPlaceholder: Add a must-have, e.g. 3+ years with Kubernetes, then press Enter
role.fairness: FastHyr never screens on name, photo, address, age or graduation year, even if they appear in a résumé.
role.niceToHavesHint: Extra skills or experience that add to the résumé score but aren't required.
role.niceToHavesPlaceholder: Add a nice-to-have, then press Enter
role.passBarHint: Résumés at or above this score, with every must-have, are invited to interview. Most teams start at 60.
role.openToHint: Tick anyone you'd welcome even without the usual track record. The résumé screen and the AI interviewer will look for potential and transferable skills in these candidates, not just years in the role.

fresh_grads.label: Fresh graduates
fresh_grads.description: Internships, school and personal projects count as experience.

career_changers.label: Career changers
career_changers.description: Skills from another field are matched to what this role needs.

returners.label: Returning to work
returners.description: Career gaps are never held against a candidate.

no_degree.label: No degree required
no_degree.description: Self-taught, bootcamp and certification paths are weighed equally.

step_up.label: Ready for a step up
step_up.description: Welcomes candidates one level below the role who show they can grow into it.

relocating.label: Relocating or remote-first
relocating.description: Location on the résumé isn't treated as a gap.

role.openToNote: We won't screen out {list} just for missing years of experience. The interviewer will also ask about their projects, transferable skills and how they learn.

video_voice.label: Video + voice
video_voice.description: Candidates talk to the AI on camera. Best when presence and integrity checks matter.

voice_only.label: Voice only
voice_only.description: Audio only, no camera. Lower pressure and easier on slow connections.

interview.adaptiveBody: There's no fixed number of questions and no timer per question. The AI builds questions from each résumé and this job, then follows up on answers the way a person would.

warm.label: Warm
warm.description: Encouraging and relaxed. Puts nervous candidates at ease.

professional.label: Professional
professional.description: Friendly but focused, like a structured panel.

direct.label: Direct
direct.description: Brisk and probing. Pushes back on vague answers.

interview.skillsHint: The interviewer makes sure each of these comes up. Add at least 3, as they're also used to score candidates. Candidates won't see this list, but you can still mention these skills in the job description so applicants are aware of them.
interview.skillsPlaceholder: Add a skill, e.g. Incident response, then press Enter
interview.reminder: Remind candidates before their link expires
interview.reminderHint: One friendly nudge 24 hours before, to cut drop-off.
interview.integrityHint: Second voice, face mismatch or read-aloud answers. Flags never auto-reject.

scoring.sumOff: Adds up to {total}%. Needs to be 100%
scoring.rubricHint: Every report shows how each part was scored, with evidence from the interview.
scoring.passMarkHint: Candidates at or above this score are marked "Recommended". You always make the final call.
scoring.rejectMail: Email candidates whose résumé isn't a match
scoring.rejectMailHint: Sent the next working day with your "Résumé not a match" template.
scoring.resultMailHint: Lets them know it's being reviewed, so nobody is left waiting in silence.

perApplicant.title: 1 applicant = 1 credit

pauses.title: Runs out? It pauses
pauses.body: New applicants wait until you add more. Other pipelines aren't touched.

returns.title: Leftovers come back
returns.body: Unused credits return to your workspace when the pipeline closes.

review.lockNowTitle: You can't edit this pipeline after publishing
review.lockNowBody: The role, interview, scoring and schedule stay fixed so every candidate is assessed the same way. If something needs to change later, you'll create a new pipeline. You can still pause, close or add credits.
review.lockLaterTitle: You can edit this pipeline until it opens on {date}
review.lockLaterBody: Until then, you can change anything from the Pipelines page. Once the first applicant can apply, the setup locks so every candidate is assessed the same way.

publish.hintNow: The setup locks once you publish
publish.dialogNowTitle: Once you publish, there's no going back
publish.dialogNowBody: You won't be able to edit the role, interview, scoring or schedule. This keeps every candidate's assessment consistent. You can still pause it, close it or add credits.
publish.dialogLaterTitle: Editing locks the moment it opens
publish.dialogLaterBody: You can keep editing this pipeline until it opens on {date}. From then on, the role, interview, scoring and schedule are locked so every candidate is assessed the same way. You can still pause it, close it or add credits.

done.pausedBody: It's paused until your workspace has credits again. Applicants can't apply until then.
done.body: Now share its apply link. Click where you'll post the job and we'll copy a tagged link, so you can see which board your applicants come from.
done.editableNote: You can still edit the setup until {date}. After it opens, the setup is locked.
